info.prompt: A cyber-gothic dice board with neural cathedral UI panels framed in skeletal gold filigree, glowing neon cyan and electric magenta circuit lines pulsing through void black space. Translucent dice hover above the board with crystalline facets refracting amber highlights, while terminal text scrolls hacker-speak along the lower border. Heat distortion shimmers around the central die as speed lines streak across the peripheral grid, all viewed through an oscilloscope-filtered lens with vignette-darkened edges that amplify the claustrophobic tension of high-stakes gameplay.
